categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: precious metal recycling, precious metal-based new materials, and trade. Precious metal recycling involves recovering platinum, palladium, rhodium, silver, and other valuable metals from secondary resources such as waste catalysts. The new materials segment processes recovered precious metals into compounds like platinum and palladium chlorides. The trade segment supports the other two by providing integrated services including procurement, transportation, and testing of precious metals and related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced hydrometallurgical and pyrometallurgical processes for precious metal recovery, including proprietary technologies such as platinum dissolution and enrichment. It utilizes ion exchange, solvent extraction, and electrochemical methods to maximize recovery rates and product purity. The company also develops new processing techniques for low-grade materials and automotive catalyst recycling, supported by in-house R&D centers and collaborations with universities and research institutes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major petroleum and petrochemical enterprises such as China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC), Sinopec, and CNOOC, as well as chemical companies and precious metal traders. The company serves industries requiring precious metals for catalysts, electronics, medical applications, and jewelry. The expanding automotive catalyst recycling market is a growing focus, leveraging existing customer relationships and technical expertise.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Xuzhou, Jiangsu Province, China, with operations primarily serving the domestic Chinese market. It has subsidiaries and investments in Shanghai, Jiangxi, and Singapore, expanding its industrial footprint. The company leverages regional industrial clusters, especially in Jiangxi, to enhance its market coverage and mitigate geographic risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream and downstream in the precious metals supply chain. It procures secondary precious metal resources from upstream industries like petrochemical and automotive sectors, processes and refines these materials, and supplies purified metals and compounds back to catalyst manufacturers and other end-users. It also provides integrated trade and logistics services, positioning itself as a comprehensive service provider within the precious metals recycling ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding precious metal recycling capacity, especially in automotive catalyst recovery, and developing new high-purity precious metal compounds. The company emphasizes technological innovation to improve recovery efficiency, reduce environmental impact, and comply with stricter regulations. R&D efforts focus on hydrometallurgical and pyrometallurgical process optimization, electrochemical methods, and new material development, supported by provincial engineering centers and national key projects.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of recovered precious metals and new material products, as well as fees from entrusted processing services. The company operates on a buy-and-sell model for secondary precious metals and compounds, with pricing linked to market metal prices and recovery rates. Trade services generate revenue by facilitating procurement and logistics for customers. The company also benefits from government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in precious metal recycling, with a strong brand and technical edge in the petrochemical catalyst recycling sector. It competes with both domestic firms and international giants entering the Chinese market, such as Heraeus. Its competitive advantages include proprietary technologies, extensive customer relationships with major state-owned enterprises, and compliance with environmental regulations, which enhance its market position amid increasing industry consolidation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.53 billion, a slight decrease of 1.63% from the previous year, mainly due to lower palladium and rhodium prices. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 104.7 million, down 28.3% year-over-year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.89 billion, growing 11.5% from 2022. Despite short-term profit pressure from market volatility and inventory impairments, the company maintains steady growth and is expanding capacity through ongoing investment projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high recovery rates and high-purity precious metal products through advanced proprietary technologies, ensuring economic and environmental efficiency. Its integrated service model—from raw material procurement to refined product supply and trade services—provides customers with reliable, one-stop solutions. Strong compliance with environmental standards and continuous innovation in processing methods differentiate the company in a competitive and regulated market, enhancing customer trust and long-term partnerships.
